name: Synn
message: 「Good work at your part-time job. You're late today.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. I went to the park to get some training in on the way back!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Lately, I've had a lot of worldly desires I need to shake off!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmh~♪ As always, Prez's curry is amazing! Even without any meat.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Look, Sally. You've got it all over your mouth!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, she's just gonna get messy again anyway.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, Big Brother, you really are such a total klutz.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the hell am I gonna do if my pristine body gets dirty!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. I'll give you a thorough hand-washing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way I'm letting hard washboards like Flat-Chest or Shorty's boobs scrub me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Though if Ria-chan gives me a soapy body-rub with her soft boobs, I'm all for it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Panda-chan is totally head over heels for Big Sis Ria, huh.」

name: Sally
message: 「Who cares? Let's us flat-chested girls get along together.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Compared to Ria-chan, it's like comparing slingshot pellets to missiles.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, big or small, it's all just individuality.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, even I have a decent amount, properly there.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You say that, but you don't actually believe me!」
Well, I mean... comparing her to Ria-senpai just isn't fair, really isn't....

name: Macaron
message: 「Fine then, why don't you touch them and see for yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-No, no way! T-T-Touching M-M-Macaron's boobs, I couldn't possibly--!」
Those modest, yet seemingly soft, perky, and self-assertive boobs--!?

name: Sally
message: 「Well then, don't mind if I do~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right! These two mounds on my chest are proof that I can do anything♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「They're packed tightly full of potential, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I make sure to drink my milk every single day, too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Lucky, lucky-- Maybe I should start drinking milk too--」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I'll share some with you too, Sally-chan.」
Because Macaron went and said something so dangerous, I ended up gushing a nosebleed in my mind.

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama.... Look, I ain't gonna badmouth your tastes or nothin'」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright, I'll go ahead and clean up now.」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it, so don't worry about it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, then we can just do it together, right.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sheesh, never gets old with you guys.」

name: Sally
message: 「Looking at us like this, we really seem like a real family, don't we?」

name: Sally
message: 「Kaicho's the dad, and Mako-chii's the mom, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm the bright little kid, and Paqy's the pet!」

name: Sally
message: 「Though in the drama, the pet wasn't a panda.」
The ratio of Demons is awfully high, though.

name: Macaron
message: 「I like it, family. Has a nice ring to it.」
She never talks about her own family at all, yet...
Just by us becoming her family, she shows me such a wonderful smile.
I want to stay Macaron's family like this forever...

name: Synn
message: 「Alright then, maybe I'll prep for tomorrow's classes and go to bed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, you okay? I'm coming in, alright?」
Looking at the hem of the coat Macaron pinched up...

name: Macaron
message: 「I must've snagged it on something while training...」

name: Synn
message: 「This coat is huge, so you didn't notice, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... it looks bad, but something like this is fixable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait right here, I'll go grab some leftover fabric and a sewing kit.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, it's fine, I'll fix it myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think we can fix it faster if we do it together.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Well, if you insist that much, I'll let you help.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Prepare to have your mind blown by my transcendent skills.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, don't pull it so hard. You're making it hard for me to work.」

name: Macaron
message: 「You should just sit back and watch in awe, big brother.」
Bickering back and forth like that, we keep stitching away bit by bit.

name: Synn
message: 「...Doing this kind of makes it feel like I really got a little sister.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Does that mean to you, Big Brother, I'm always going to be just like a little sister?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No, that's not what I meant, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I was kind of hoping we could get just a little closer, or something...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Thinking shameless thoughts about your own little sister again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, when you call me 'Big Brother' all the time, it kind of puts me in that mindset...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Then how about I try calling you something else?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll try something other than 'Big Brother,' okay!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Dear Brother, you're leaving far too much slack in the thread!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Dear Brother, would you be a darling and pass me that sewing pin over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes... wait, isn't that kind of missing the point?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Bro! You're surprisingly bad at sewing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, that doesn't really feel all that different from usual.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whaaat!? I'm not that much of a delinquent!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... More importantly, why does your personality change along with what you call me?」

name: Synn
message: 「And in the end, the 'older brother' part still doesn't change, huh... 」

name: Macaron
message: 「I guess what I'm used to really is best. Right, Big Brother?」
As long as our feelings get across to each other, what she calls me doesn't really matter.
Whether they're actually getting across is another story, though...

name: Synn
message: 「A-ahaha, I'm fine, I'm fine. I spaced out for a second and poked myself.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, you're such a klutz. Let me see.」
Snatched away without a word, my hand was brought right up to Macaron's lips--
Spreading across my fingertip was a numbing warmth and a sensual wetness...
Drawn in by Macaron's lips, the blood oozing from my fingertip is slowly licked away.

name: Macaron
message: 「I have to lick it to disinfect it, or germs might get in, right?」
I'd better keep the tactless thought that I could've just licked it myself to myself...

name: Synn
message: 「...Turns out you're the one sucking on fingers, Macaron.」
And so, with one thing and another, the night grows late...

name: Macaron
message: 「Haah!? I-I'm not asleep! I'm not sleepy at all, okay?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're tired from your part-time job and training, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take care of the rest, so go on and get some sleep first, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Y-You say that, but you're planning to do something weird after I fall asleep, aren't you...」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh!? I wouldn't do anything like that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're gonna embroider something lame on the back of my coat or something...」
Just like that, she flops over onto her side.
Once I finish this up, I'll drape a blanket over her or something.
I'm starting to get sleepy myself, so I'd better hurry and finish this.
As I gaze at her in admiration, my eyelids start growing heavy.
Quickly threading the needle through, the coat is safely as good as new.
I gently drape the newly mended coat over Macaron.
